notes.title: Quick Update and Thank You!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It’s been a hectic week, but I just wanted to thank you all for your support and for taking the time to play the game that I’ve created. It means the world to me, and I’m going to try my best to get the rest of the chapters out to you as soon as I can!

Minor update
I noticed that if you use the Chapter jump from the main menu, it didn’t ask for your name and used the default name instead. My apologies if this affected you, I’ve now added this to the list of questions.
If you’re affected by this, or you just want to change your name, you can now go to the temp shop app on the second page of your in-game phone and type in the code: changemyname. In the future, I’ll have an additional way to change your name as well.

Germany Players
If you live in Germany, I’m sure you already know that you cannot purchase the DLC. I’m genuinely sorry, I wish there were some way for you to play it on Steam, but right now, until there are some changes on Steam, I’m not sure when that will be. 

Although not ideal, there are other platforms to receive the game. The closest to the release format on Steam would be on itch.io, but that is about a month away from release. There’s also Patreon and Subscribestar, but they do follow a very different release format. In the future, the plan is for Time For You to be available to purchase on zero2herogames.com as well. 

Chapter 03
Next month I’ll be showing off some of the new locations you’ll be visiting in Chapter 03, along with some of the characters you’ll see.


Also, if you have some time, consider leaving a review. I would really appreciate it! As a new indie developer, any traction helps :)


More news soon, and thanks for the support!

If you haven’t already, follow Zero2HeroGames on Twitter and Instagram for Time For You news and future contests to win some Steam keys! If you’re interested in Time For You BETA releases, Dev updates, monthly lewd wallpapers, and other bonuses, you can get that all at my Patreon or Subscribestar.

Cheers,

ZeroHero

notes.title: Chapter 02 Progress and Chapter 03 News
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I know you’re all waiting for Chapter 02. I’m working on it, however, it is taking a bit longer than planned. I’ve been in contact with Valve and they’ve been very helpful, but in order to be in-line with Steam, I do need to make some changes. Don’t worry, this won’t affect gameplay at all, but the format of how the rest of the game will be released on Steam, and the programming needs some changes. 

The main difference will be that instead of a Chapter pass including Chapters 1-12, a Chapter pass for Chapters 1-4 will be released first and in the future, 5-8, and 9-12 will be released. You’ll be able to purchase 5-8 and 9-12 as a complete-the-set bundle in the future, which will discount the game in total to the same or a similar cost that was previously mentioned.

Hold on a bit longer. Once this Chapter is ready and added to Steam, future Chapters should take significantly less time to be added as well. My apologies for the delay.

As a small gift for the extra wait, I’ll be making another free Steam exclusive in-game phone wallpaper, but I’ll need your help. Post a comment of the character who you want to see more of below, and the character in the most comments will have a phone wallpaper made for them. I’ll post the code in the future.

https://i.imgur.com/EEO4RD1.png
1. Vanessa
2. Serah
3. Selena
4. Mandy
5. ELVO
6. Ellie

Chapter 03 - News

In other news, Chapter 03 is in full swing! The first part will be finished in a few days, and the development of the rest of the Chapter is going well. There are a lot more new characters and locations coming! Chapter 03 is when the lewd content really ramps up, so that’s something to look forward to :)

Thank you all for the support, and thanks for your patience.

If you haven’t already, follow Zero2HeroGames on Twitter and Instagram for Time For You news and future contests to win some Steam keys! If you’re interested in Time For You BETA releases, Dev updates, monthly lewd wallpapers, and other bonuses, you can get that all at my Patreon or Subscribestar.

Cheers,

ZeroHero
